title: Greek Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing salad with juicy chicken, crunchy veggies, and tangy Greek flavors.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
4. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
5. In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced cucumber, diced tomato, and thinly sliced red onion.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek salad dressing and a pinch of salt.
7. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
8. Top the salad with sliced grilled chicken and crumbled feta cheese.
